source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
subject: a clearly adult 34-year-old woman working as a textile conservator, with facial appearance supplied only by the provided adult reference
setting: a decommissioned coastal hydrographic observatory and specimen archive at 04:40 before dawn
event: she is frozen midway through a measured clockwise pivot and reach from an open specimen drawer toward a swinging tide-gauge ribbon
visual_priorities: show the movement start and unfinished destination simultaneously
keep the support-foot and joint path anatomically continuous
connect an alert gaze to the exact task destination
show fabric, hair, hand, and object lag in the same travel direction
baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-length fashion editorial photograph inside a decommissioned coastal hydrographic observatory at 04:40 before dawn. A clearly adult 34-year-old woman, a textile conservator whose facial appearance follows the provided adult facial-appearance reference, is caught midway through a measured clockwise pivot from an open specimen drawer toward a slowly swinging brass tide-gauge ribbon. Her left foot is fully planted on a dry brass-grate strip, while her right heel has just lifted and her bent knee continues toward the instrument, keeping an anatomically continuous support path. Her torso still begins at the drawer, yet her reaching right hand remains a handspan short of the ribbon knot, so both the starting point and unfinished destination read in one frame. Her alert eyes lock on that knot. An opaque garnet bias-cut satin coatdress over a high-neck shell, its hem, one loose strand of hair, her reaching fingers, and the calibration ribbon all trail slightly behind the same clockwise travel. Include a rolled hydrographic chart under her left arm. Use a low three-quarter full-body 50 mm composition, crisp high-shutter timing, cool lighthouse slats, and a warm tungsten archive lamp.
